items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Diane Louie writes music for me.

ctx.x: It was produced by Leroy Robinson, directed by George Michael, who is now on 20/20, and I think Darlene Chan was involved.
I said Diane Louie. I meant Darlene Chan, who was my stage manager. Diane Louie writes music for me.
That must have been a pretty darn good show, if you got bumped by Saturday Night Live.
